title: GERT Package Lock v1
description: Structural contract for .gert/packages.lock.json with apiVersion: package-lock/v1. This is a generated, committed, frozen integrity record — NOT a solver output (.squad/decisions/archive/barbara-tool-packages-architecture-ruling.md, AR-TP-3 / §3.5). Lock presence is OPTIONAL for 'gert run'; when present, a digest mismatch is PKG-009. 'gert verify' extends to check this file.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema declaration for IDE tooling.

generatedBy.description: Identifier of the tool version that generated this lock file, e.g. 'gert/2.3.1'.

packages.description: One entry per resolved package in the run's global package set (design/gert/sections/02-architecture.tex §Include/Import Graph). Sorted ascending by 'name' for determinism.

catalogDigest.description: The order-independent catalog digest (design/gert/sections/06-tool-runtime.tex §Digest, Evidence, Trace, Resume). 'sha256:' followed by 64 lowercase hex characters.

version.description: The resolved package's strict SemVer 2.0.0 version, as declared in its gert-package.yaml meta.version. A leading 'v' is rejected, not stripped (PKG-025), matching PackageMeta.version in tool-package.v1.schema.json.

root.description: Workspace-relative POSIX path to the package root. For packages resolved outside the workspace, this field takes the form 'external:sha256:<digest of the absolute realpath, UTF-8, NFC>' instead of a raw absolute path — raw absolute paths leak usernames and host layout into committed artefacts and traces. The first alternative is deliberately NOT '[^\x00]+': it requires a relative, forward-slash POSIX path (no leading '/', no drive letter, no backslash, no '..' segment) so that a raw absolute path can never validate under either branch — the invariant is enforced structurally, not just by convention.

digest.description: The package's deterministic, order-free content digest (§Digest, Evidence, Trace, Resume, 'Package digest').

id.description: Bare tool name, matching the package manifest's exports.tools[].id.

path.description: Package-root-relative POSIX path to the .tool.yaml, matching the package manifest's exports.tools[].path.

digest.description: The raw-byte SHA-256 file digest of the .tool.yaml at the time of locking.
